headline: Berm Tips Colonial; Expanse Reopens; Nevish Toll Mounts
war_summary: Since the last edition closed, the scales have shifted in three regions at once. Palantine Berm, scene of more than fifty flag actions in a day about Vendett and Windburn Landing, now shows five posts under Colonial colors against two Warden. The Weathered Expanse, reported solidly Warden only hours ago, has broken open again: another stronghold lies in ruin, leaving six Warden and three no-man's-land, with fresh blows logged as this edition went to press at Spirit Watch and Crow's Nest. Stonecradle gave a post back to the Wardens, seven Colonial to two, The Dais and The Reach still contested. On the Stlican Shelf the ledger swells at a frightful pace, some fourteen hundred losses in two hours, though its seven-to-two Colonial line holds and no flag has moved in three hours. Linn Mercy's terrible account cools a shade, yet flags moved there within the hour about Outwich Ranch and Lathair. Grimmest is the Nevish Line: more than a thousand Colonial and over five hundred Warden losses in two hours without a flag stirring since early evening. Marban Hollow and the Gutter rest quiet. Thirty-four victory towns remain the prize; neither side claims the war.
